chart_patterns.name: KPI tile
chart_patterns.encodes: one value with label and context note
chart_patterns.watch_out: A row of tiles with no comparison says nothing about direction.

chart_patterns.name: KPI tile with delta badge
chart_patterns.encodes: value plus period-over-period change, colour by polarity
chart_patterns.watch_out: State whether the delta is percent or percentage points, and colour by whether the move is good, not by its sign.

chart_patterns.name: Ranked horizontal bar
chart_patterns.encodes: category on y, value on x, sorted
chart_patterns.best_for: Long category labels such as cancel reasons or products
chart_patterns.watch_out: Show the volume behind each rate or small groups look as important as large ones.

chart_patterns.name: Vertical bar
chart_patterns.encodes: few categories, one measure
chart_patterns.watch_out: Needs a zero baseline.

chart_patterns.name: Grouped bar
chart_patterns.encodes: categories by series side by side
chart_patterns.best_for: Comparing periods per product or month
chart_patterns.watch_out: More than three series becomes hard to read.

chart_patterns.name: Grouped bar, dual axis
chart_patterns.encodes: two measures with different units per category
chart_patterns.best_for: Cycles and cancel share by group
chart_patterns.watch_out: Two axes invite false visual comparisons between series.

chart_patterns.name: Bar and line combo, dual axis
chart_patterns.encodes: volume as bars, rate as line on second axis
chart_patterns.watch_out: Axis ranges set the apparent relationship between the two series.

chart_patterns.name: Stacked bar
chart_patterns.encodes: parts of a total per category
chart_patterns.best_for: Recovered vs lost, recurring vs one-time
chart_patterns.watch_out: Only the bottom segment has a common baseline.

chart_patterns.name: 100% stacked bar
chart_patterns.encodes: share mix per category
chart_patterns.watch_out: Hides the size of each category.

chart_patterns.name: Stacked bar over time
chart_patterns.encodes: category contribution per period
chart_patterns.best_for: New lines by category per month
chart_patterns.watch_out: Middle segments are hard to track over time.

chart_patterns.name: Positive and negative bar
chart_patterns.encodes: net change coloured by sign
chart_patterns.watch_out: Needs a clear zero line.

chart_patterns.name: Doughnut
chart_patterns.encodes: few shares of one whole
chart_patterns.watch_out: Small slices are unreadable, so label values.

chart_patterns.name: Cohort retention curves
chart_patterns.encodes: one line per cohort over checkpoints
chart_patterns.watch_out: A truncated y-axis exaggerates small gaps.

chart_patterns.name: Line with area fill
chart_patterns.encodes: one measure over time
chart_patterns.watch_out: Area fill implies a zero baseline.

chart_patterns.name: Small-multiple trend grid
chart_patterns.encodes: several KPIs on matching mini charts
chart_patterns.watch_out: Independent y-axes on each tile.

chart_patterns.name: Cumulative threshold bar
chart_patterns.encodes: share reached by each threshold
chart_patterns.watch_out: Do not mix cumulative bars with incremental or state bars on one axis.

chart_patterns.name: Particle replay with diverging stacked area
chart_patterns.encodes: one particle per session falling to an exit line, saves stacked above by treatment, losses below, daily rate pulse strip
chart_patterns.best_for: Emotional storytelling of a month of cancel sessions
chart_patterns.watch_out: Non-linear pacing and no axes, so it cannot be read for exact values.

chart_patterns.name: Table with verdict pills
chart_patterns.encodes: rows of metrics with a Read column
chart_patterns.watch_out: Rubric thresholds are rarely written down.

chart_patterns.name: Period comparison table
chart_patterns.encodes: metric rows by period columns with change columns
chart_patterns.watch_out: Label partial periods.

chart_patterns.name: Table with inline share bars
chart_patterns.encodes: rows with a small bar showing share
chart_patterns.watch_out: Bars must share one scale.

chart_patterns.name: Vertical split gauge
chart_patterns.encodes: thin bar filled to a share beside a value
chart_patterns.watch_out: Too small to compare more than two values.

ui_patterns.name: Executive summary
ui_patterns.description: Opening block of headline findings.

ui_patterns.name: Takeaway strip
ui_patterns.description: One-paragraph summary above the KPI grid.

ui_patterns.name: KPI grid

ui_patterns.name: Typed insight callout

ui_patterns.name: Data-quality warning
ui_patterns.description: Inline note that flags a confound, subset or caveat.

ui_patterns.name: Numbered pattern cards with fix
ui_patterns.description: Pattern statement, evidence and a boxed fix.

ui_patterns.name: Recommended actions list

ui_patterns.name: Discussion topic cards with status
ui_patterns.description: Agenda items tagged planned, live or proposed.

ui_patterns.name: Tabbed panels

ui_patterns.name: Collapsible reveal

ui_patterns.name: Methodology panel
ui_patterns.description: Dedicated section on scope, definitions, exclusions and limits.

ui_patterns.name: Provenance footer
ui_patterns.description: Source, store, period and preparer.

ui_patterns.name: Product spotlight cards

ui_patterns.name: Start and end cards

ui_patterns.name: Live scoreboard
ui_patterns.description: Running totals that update as an animation plays.

ui_patterns.name: Celebration effect
ui_patterns.description: Confetti on first reveal.

ui_patterns.name: Hover tooltips and legend toggles
ui_patterns.description: Interactive chart details.

ui_patterns.name: Ranked roadmap rows
ui_patterns.description: Numbered initiatives with body text and an impact tag.

ui_patterns.name: Action matrix with effort
ui_patterns.description: Table of actions with why, where in the build and effort.
